name: BEF HTML5 Date plugin
description: A Better Exposed Filters widget plugin that renders Views exposed date filters as native HTML5 date inputs.
project_description: BEF plugin allowing to use HTML5 date fields in views exposed filters. It registers a Better Exposed Filters filter-widget plugin (id bef_html5_date, label "HTML5 Date") that switches an exposed Views date filter to a native HTML5 date input (#type date) so the browser's built-in date picker is used instead of a plain text field. The plugin applies to Views date filters and filters that declare a date_handler, and is selected per-filter in the Better Exposed Filters settings. The module has no routes, permissions, services, config, or settings of its own.
